description.value: A family-owned Vietnamese restaurant that has been serving Victoria since 1986, making it one of the city's most enduring independent eateries. The menu features authentic dishes including grilled lemongrass pork, aromatic pho, and rich coconut curry, all made with fresh ingredients and traditional recipes. Located on Langley Street in downtown Victoria, it's a welcoming sit-down option for cyclists passing through the city core.
